question: Do the cited projector-level D4 sources and frozen code determine an action-conditioned cross-round transition on only vacuum/m_flux/e_charge labels?
epistemic_role: Necessary-condition and source-provenance audit; not a D4 kernel fit or performance experiment

primary_sources.scope: Appendix A.4 post-flux even-parity components of physical-plus-correction union; Appendix D time-ordered errors and syndrome projectors
Appendix B complete D(G) projector family; Appendix D.2 ordered density-channel composition for measurement and correction

frozen_exact_matrix: Verify pinned local inputs and source-supported physical-chain XOR for no fault/no action, one fault/no action, and one fault/cancelling correction. This checks only the abelian red-X flux-chain frame, not hidden D4 fusion.

Evaluate a minimal three-dimensional generic projector example with a rank-two coarse-label subspace, two distinct states sharing that label, and an action-conditioned unitary followed by a second projector. Test whether their future outcome probabilities differ. This is a counterexample to automatic coarse-label closure, not a D4-specific failure claim.

Apply the symbolic lumpability condition Pi_x U^dagger Pi_y U Pi_x = k Pi_x to the generic example; map each cited D4 source and local implementation to what it fixes and what cross-round microscopic/density state it does not fix.
acceptance: All four pinned hashes pass before exact calculation; matrix and symbolic condition are exact and reproducible.
The red-X chain identity is separated from hidden projector/charge transition; a generic rank-two counterexample is never presented as a D4 physical counterexample.
The conclusion says only whether the currently cited sources and frozen local implementation specify a unique numeric three-label action-conditioned law; missing derivation fails closed.
No new stochastic history, schedule arm, bootstrap, threshold, LER, or JIT-benefit result is generated.
stop_rule: On provenance mismatch or exact-check failure, censor this audit. Even on a pass, do not promote the stipulated J6C feedback table, alter the integrated generator, or resume performance sampling; next derive a D4 geometry-matched two-round projector/density-state fixture and test its action feedback before numerical kernel or caller claims.
